SELECT e.id AS id, e.application_id AS applicationId, e.object_id AS objectId, o.object_code AS objectCode, o.object_name AS objectName, e.entry_id AS entryId, entry_row.app_name AS entryName, e.extension_code AS extensionCode, e.extension_name AS extensionName, e.extension_type AS extensionType, e.hook_code AS hookCode, e.scope_type AS scopeType, e.scope_key AS scopeKey, e.sort_order AS sortOrder, e.failure_policy AS failurePolicy, e.risk_level AS riskLevel, e.status AS status, e.draft_version AS draftVersion, e.enabled_version AS enabledVersion, e.lock_user_id AS lockUserId, e.lock_username AS lockUsername, e.lock_expire_time AS lockExpireTime, v.content AS content, v.processed_content AS processedContent, v.config_json AS configJson, v.validation_passed AS validationPassed, v.validation_summary AS validationSummary, v.test_passed AS testPassed, v.test_summary AS testSummary, e.remark AS remark, e.create_time AS createTime, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_business_extension e LEFT JOIN ai_business_extension_version v ON v.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND v.extension_id = e.id AND v.version_no = e.draft_version AND v.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND o.id = e.object_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_business_app entry_row ON entry_row.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND entry_row.id = e.entry_id AND entry_row.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: ORDER BY e.sort_order ASC, e.extension_code ASC, e.id ASC

SELECT e.id AS id, e.application_id AS applicationId, e.object_id AS objectId, o.object_code AS objectCode, o.object_name AS objectName, e.entry_id AS entryId, entry_row.app_name AS entryName, e.extension_code AS extensionCode, e.extension_name AS extensionName, e.extension_type AS extensionType, e.hook_code AS hookCode, e.scope_type AS scopeType, e.scope_key AS scopeKey, e.sort_order AS sortOrder, e.failure_policy AS failurePolicy, e.risk_level AS riskLevel, e.status AS status, e.draft_version AS draftVersion, e.enabled_version AS enabledVersion, e.update_time AS updateTime FROM ai_business_extension e LEFT JOIN ai_business_object o ON o.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND o.id = e.object_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN ai_business_app entry_row ON entry_row.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND entry_row.id = e.entry_id AND entry_row.del_flag = '0' WHERE e.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND e.application_id = #{applicationId} AND e.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY e.sort_order ASC, e.extension_code ASC, e.id ASC
